_doc: Konfigurasi OTA Flash Bootloader TM81. Device harus dalam mode App saat memulai. Ubah fw_version ke path BL binary yang sesuai sebelum flash.
label: TM81 OTA Bootloader
_doc_tests: Urutan OTA Bootloader: Unlock (5-knock) → Write BL firmware → Activate. Device harus di App mode saat mulai.

tests.name: user_reset_config
tests.label: User Reset Config
tests.description: Reset konfigurasi user ke default sebelum OTA

tests.name: user_get_config
tests.label: Get User Config
tests.description: Verifikasi config sudah ter-reset — cek Activation harus Deactivated

tests.name: bl_unlock
tests.label: BL Unlock (5-Knock)
tests.description: Kirim BL_GOTO_APP 5x (semua NAK = normal) untuk membuka guard OTA Bootloader. Device harus di App mode.

tests.name: write_fw
tests.label: Write BL Firmware
tests.description: Transfer chunk firmware Bootloader ke device via IrDA (resume support). Fresh transfer otomatis clear metadata dulu.

tests.name: bl_goto_app
tests.label: Activate Bootloader
tests.description: Validasi image BL lalu soft reset ke Bootloader baru (safety gate aktif — tolak jika image belum lengkap)

tests.name: get_version
tests.label: Get Firmware Version
tests.description: Baca versi App dan Bootloader — verifikasi BL baru berhasil aktif

tests.name: get_id
tests.label: Get Device ID
tests.description: Baca Device ID dari memori - validasi set_id
